_doc: A hobby AS5600 magnetic encoder board and its 6 mm magnet. The chip's figures are ams's own; the board's are community until measured, because many unbranded boards share the name. Its two mounting holes' spacing varies between makers and is left out: measure yours. The magnet sits on the shaft under the chip, centred on the axis. kind as in x1c.json. Board in the x-y plane, chip on top.
